# Steve P / SPDUK

> Steve is a Senior Software Engineer building AI products and frontend systems, based in Cambridge, UK. This interactive portfolio collects his projects, writing, browser games and experiments.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://spdevuk.com/): About Steve, selected work and his current engineering role.
- [Projects](https://spdevuk.com/projects/): This portfolio and an archive of earlier projects with their original dates and articles.
- [Writing](https://spdevuk.com/blog/): Notes on software development and the tools Steve uses.
- [Arcade](https://spdevuk.com/arcade/): Browser versions of Asteroids, Snake and Breakout with keyboard and touch controls.
- [Signal Lab](https://spdevuk.com/signal-lab/): An interactive Canvas experiment for shaping animated patterns and saving a frame.
- [About this site](https://spdevuk.com/made-with/): How the desktop interface, saved workspace, article pages, games and visual experiment work.
- [Contact](https://spdevuk.com/contact/): Steve's email and GitHub profile.

## Skills And Topics

- AI products and frontend systems
- React and TypeScript
- Frontend architecture
- Creative coding and Canvas rendering
- Browser games and simulation
- Gatsby article rendering

## Current Work

At [Zuora](https://www.zuora.com/), Steve is a Senior Software Engineer & Forward Deployed Engineer focused on AI. He builds product experiences and works with customers to turn practical problems into working software.

## Useful For

Use this site to explore Steve's engineering work, read his technical writing, or try the games and visual experiments he built for the portfolio. Earlier project articles are historical work and retain their original publication dates.
